entries: **Self-heal no longer takes over a user's own script that merely shares part of a hook's filename.** Both the hook-removal path and the migration path that keeps an installed hook's command current used a plain substring check against markers like `usage-terse-mode`, so a user's own script — say, a backup named `usage-terse-mode-backup.py` — matched and was silently rewritten to the official command. The removal path was fixed first, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary around the marker and a trailing `.py`; the same precise check is now used at the four remaining call sites in the migration logic that decide whether to overwrite a hook's command.

**Language detection no longer misreads plain English words as Japanese or Korean, or a made-up Chinese-script tag as a real one.** The `_normalize_lang` logic — duplicated across four files — matched `ja`/`ko` with an unbounded `startswith`, so `jargon` and `koala` were read as Japanese and Korean; a POSIX `@modifier` suffix wasn't stripped, so `zh_TW@variant` fell through to English; and `zh-HK` didn't accept further BCP 47 subtags the way `zh-TW`/`zh-Hant` did. A second pass found the same unbounded-prefix bug in `zh-Hant`/`zh-Hans` (letting a nonsense `zh-Hantasy` match as Traditional Chinese) and a missing `zh-SG-` prefix (dropping a legitimate `zh-SG-x-private` tag to English). All four duplicated copies now require a boundary after every prefix.

**A non-UTF-8 terminal no longer crashes terse mode or session resume, and a truncated or corrupted version marker no longer wedges self-heal.** The SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit hooks wrote JSON without `ensure_ascii`, so a terminal using an encoding like cp950 raised `UnicodeEncodeError` and lost the entire message; output is now forced to ASCII-safe JSON with the write wrapped in `try`/`except OSError`. The four version-marker readers used `split` and choked on a truncated line or invalid bytes, which meant a broken installed script was never recognized as needing reinstalling; they now use `partition` and also catch `UnicodeDecodeError`. Separately, a stale terse-mode sidecar whose content had rotted was never rebuilt as long as the hook version hadn't changed, because staleness was checked with a plain `exists()`; it's now checked by validating the sidecar's content.

**Session resume's stdin and stdout failures are handled the same way its sibling hooks already were, and a corrupted newest session log falls back to an older one instead of going silent.** `_read_stdin_utf8()` could raise `OSError` on a broken pipe, and unlike terse mode and the terse reminder, session resume didn't catch it — an I/O hiccup crashed the hook instead of exiting 0. Separately, `_parse_session()` caught `OSError` but not `UnicodeDecodeError`, so a session log with invalid UTF-8 bytes made the whole resume prompt disappear instead of falling through to the next older, valid log the way an empty log already did.

**The health-check reminder's own state write no longer takes the whole resume prompt down with it, a bare punctuation reply is no longer read as a real request, and a newly created but uncommitted directory now shows up in the "not saved yet" list.** Saving the health-check reminder's dedup state could raise `OSError` (a full disk, a permissions error) and that exception propagated out far enough to swallow the main resume prompt along with it; it's now scoped with `contextlib.suppress(OSError)`. Separately, `_has_structural_signal` treated any punctuation anywhere in the text as a sign of real content, so short replies like `ok.` or `/clear` were kept as if they were substantive; it now requires alphanumeric characters on both sides of the mark. And `git status`'s trailing slash on an untracked directory path made `basename` return an empty string, which was silently dropped, so a brand-new uncommitted folder never appeared in the uncommitted-work summary.

**A todo list is now cleared once every item on it is marked done.** The resume hook only overwrote its stored todo list when the new one was non-empty, so the last `TodoWrite` call of a session — the one that marks everything complete, leaving an empty list — was ignored, and the next session's resume prompt kept reporting work that was already finished.

**The quota-restored notification fires again, and a warning now fires on the very first reading if quota is already past the threshold.** Any reading below 100% cleared the "was depleted" flag, regardless of how small the drop was, so by the time a genuine reset was detected — a single-step drop large enough to distinguish a real period rollover from noise — the flag had already been cleared by an earlier, tiny fluctuation, and the restored notification never fired. It's now cleared only by that same reset detection. Separately, a warning threshold could only be crossed relative to a previous reading, so quota that was already above the threshold on the very first observation — for instance, the app launching mid-session at 95% — produced no warning at all, unlike the depleted notification, which always fires on a first reading of 100%.

**A dead plist key was removed, and a Windows registry read failure can no longer take down the whole tray menu.** `StartDelay` isn't a key `launchd.plist(5)` recognizes, so it had no effect and was doing nothing since it was added; it's gone. Separately, the Windows login-item's `is_enabled()` caught only `FileNotFoundError`, but it's called once per menu render to draw the "launch at login" checkbox — a registry permission error there propagated out and could break the whole tray menu instead of just that one row; it now catches any `OSError` and reports "not enabled."

**Terse mode's plain-language rule now also covers text pasted verbatim from a subagent.** The mode's own prompt only governed sentences Claude wrote itself, leaving no instruction for handling a subagent's report or a tool's raw output when quoted directly — jargon inside it went unexplained. A line was added after the existing "explain a term on first use" rule, in all five languages.

entries: **Grok CLI now gets its own `usage` status line.** Grok CLI supports the same command-style status line mechanism as Claude Code, so `usage_statusline_grok.py` joins the existing install / remove / self-heal flow behind the switch already shared with Claude Code and Antigravity. Grok's stdin payload carries no rate-limit summary (its documentation says so explicitly), so the script tails `~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl` for `creditUsagePercent` and `currentPeriod.end`; when neither can be read the segment is omitted rather than printed as placeholder characters. Only the weekly axis is shown — Grok has no 5-hour window and reports no cache hit ratio, and neither is estimated.

**The status line's second row now shows prompt cache hit rate and a countdown to expiry.** Claude Code 2.1.251 added a `prompt_cache` object to the status line hook's stdin JSON; `usage` was already storing the whole payload in `usage-status.json` without reading it. A new `color_by_pct_inverted()` mirrors the thresholds, so a 91% hit rate reads as good instead of borrowing the quota palette's red, and `progress_bar()` takes an optional `color_func` leaving existing callers unchanged. The segment is skipped entirely when `caching_observed` is not `True` or the ratio is unavailable, so older Claude Code versions silently omit it; an expired `expires_at` drops only the countdown and keeps the bar. Narrow terminals degrade in two further steps: the countdown goes first, then the whole segment.

**The HTML report's usage habits section now has a first-pass rate, compared across models.** The card measures what share of your turns this period ran without an interruption and without a blocked tool call, split by model — a quality axis rather than another quota count. Both signals are structural, read from `~/.claude/projects`: `interruptedMessageId` on user lines, and permission-denial strings inside `tool_result` content; nothing is inferred semantically. The denominator is user turns rather than assistant messages, because a single exchange emits a dozen assistant messages and would compress every model above 99.5%. Multiple interruptions inside one turn count once. Angle-bracketed internal markers such as `<synthetic>` are excluded. Interrupted assistant messages are frequently aborted before reaching disk, so unresolvable signals go to an unattributed bucket and are not shown rather than being assigned to a model. The insight line is written only when the spread between the highest and lowest model exceeds 15 points.

**The report's trend section now draws a day-by-day curve for the period, and prints properly.** `daily_trend` already held 30 days of data that no chart used, leaving the peak day named in the header with nothing to check it against. A daily area line now sits above the weekly rollup, marking the highest day and labelling only the period's first and last dates. The stylesheet also gained a `@media print` block: sections avoid internal page breaks, interactive controls are hidden, shadows and offsets are removed, and colors invert to dark-on-white so a PDF stays readable when the reader is in dark mode.

**The report's heaviest-sessions table, active-hours chart, and section rhythm were filled in.** The five heaviest sessions were the report's only all-text table; the tokens column now carries a thin bar scaled against the largest of the five, colored by the same provider palette the model table uses. The active-hours chart, previously hour labels alone, now marks its peak value in muted type in the lower right, with no gridlines or Y axis added. The ten sections shared one identical treatment; insights and the heatmap now carry heavier shadows while the recent-work and tools sections are lighter with `--faint` borders — shadows and borders only, since the persona section holds two cards and a background change would make their height difference conspicuous.

**Project and model rows in the report now carry share bars.** Comparing ten stacked rows previously meant reading the numbers; each name now has a 4px solid proportion bar beneath it — solid rather than gradient, so the color is not misread as carrying meaning. The donut's "Other" slice, which used to draw the palette's seventh color and read as nearly the same green as the first, is now a neutral `#8b8577`, selected inside `_donut_svg` by a synthetic flag rather than guessed from its index.

**A third-party status line with a similar name is no longer mistaken for our own.** Hook ownership was decided by the substring test `"usage-statusline" in cmd`, so someone else's `usage-statusline-pro.py` was treated as a `usage` installation: taken over without a backup, and its configuration deleted on uninstall. The comparison now matches the complete filename, derived from `HOOK_TARGET.name` and its siblings instead of a hardcoded string, requiring a path separator, quote, whitespace, or string boundary on each side. It deliberately does not compare full paths — the command string shifts with interpreter location, quoting, and Windows backslashes, and a path comparison would stop `usage` recognizing itself.

**The status line's file lock now times out instead of hanging a message.** `_exclusive_lock()`'s POSIX branch used a plainly blocking `flock(LOCK_EX)` while the Windows branch already had a 10-second `_LOCK_TIMEOUT_S` guard, so a process holding the lock stalled the status line on every message. The POSIX branch now polls with `LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB` and, on timeout, follows the `msvcrt` path: the atomic write proceeds without the lock.

**Uninstalling now restores Grok's original status line.** `unsetup()` handled Claude Code and Codex but skipped Grok, so after `--unsetup` the user's `~/.grok/config.toml` still pointed at a `usage` script with no supported way back to their own `[ui.status_line]`. The old test exercised only the private `_unsetup_grok()`, which is why this slipped through; the new one enters through the public `unsetup()`.

**Interruptions and denied tools on messages with no model name are no longer dropped.** A message carrying `message.id` but no `message.model` was indexed as an empty string, while the later check tested only `model is None` — so those events were neither attributed to a model nor counted as unattributed, undercounting interruptions in the first-pass rate.

**The Antigravity model name no longer mixes two languages.** Antigravity's `display_name` already ends in an English effort suffix such as `(High)`, and `usage` appended a localized one after it, naming the same level twice in two languages. The English suffix is now stripped and only the localized label is kept; when `display_name` carries no effort field, the stripped suffix becomes the source.

**Installed status line copies now actually update.** `needs_update()` compares `__version__` in `~/.claude/usage-statusline.py` against `HOOK_VERSION` and skips the copy when they match, so rendering changes that shipped without a version bump never reached an installed copy, silently and with no error. Both constants were bumped, and a drift test was added — the Token Saver hook had that guard already; the status line was missing it.

**A week still in progress is no longer compared against a complete one.** The weekly trend measured the current partial week against the previous full one, which on Monday 2026-08-31 produced "W36 ↘ −97%" and the conclusion that this week was 97% lighter. The final week is now marked in progress when its Sunday falls after `date_to` (new `trend_week_in_progress` key, added in all five languages) and shows no percentage, and `_trend_summary()` compares the last two completed weeks instead.

**A report with no usage now renders a clean empty state.** At zero usage the narrative sentence interpolated zeros and placeholders — "---- -- -- was the peak (0/day), main LLM 未知" — above seven sections each saying only "nothing here yet", which is what a new user saw on first open. When both `total_tokens` and `messages` are zero the narrative is replaced by `report_empty_state_hint` (added in all five languages) and only the header, stat cards, and sponsor section render. Output with data is byte-identical; the untouched `full_zh_tw` and `full_en` snapshots are the proof.

**The heatmap's month labels no longer skip or mislabel a month.** A column's month was taken from its Monday, so a week spanning a month boundary was credited to the old month it barely touched, and a label suppressed by the spacing rule was lost permanently — real output dropped September entirely. The month is now read from the column's Thursday and compared against the last month actually labelled, so a suppressed month reappears at the next column that satisfies the spacing.

**The project donut's percentages now agree with the table beneath it.** The donut divided by the sum of `by_project[:10]` while the table's percentage used total tokens, so one project showed 42.5% in the chart and 36.1% in the table, and the center figure read as a total it was not. The denominator is now `summary.total_tokens`, with everything not shown — including projects outside the top ten — combined into an "Other" slice reusing the existing `report_chart_other` string.

**The status line dims what isn't the number.** Empty progress cells, the context window total, and the `|` separators were pure white and brighter than the figures themselves; they are now grey 240 / dim, leaving usage as the only lit element. The second row is secondary information, so a cache hit rate of 80% or better takes that row's muted purple and only turns orange below 80% and red below 50% — good news does not need to glow.

**The cache countdown now says "left", matching the 5-hour and 7-day segments.** The previous wording was a literal rendering of warm/cold that read as nothing in particular; it now reuses the existing `remaining_prefix`, giving `(59min left)` in English alongside the two segments before it. `cache_cold_suffix`, used in exactly one place, was removed, so five languages no longer need a separate word for it.
**The menu bar title tightened up.** The interpunct separator was removed, since the provider icons already separate the figures, and icon spacing was reduced to two spaces.

**Weekly burn trend bars are now CSS gradients.** The weekly trend drew its bars with `█` characters while the donut, heatmap, and active-hours chart on the same page were graphical. The four-column layout and terminal styling are unchanged; the rendering moved into a new `ui/report_charts.py`.

Documented prompt cache health in all five READMEs under real-time visibility, noting it needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer, and removed the website's description of the AI Tool Update Digest, a report section that no longer exists.

body.zh-TW: 報表標題早就寫著這段期間的高峰日，你卻沒有任何圖可以對照——`daily_trend` 裡放著 30 天的資料，沒有任何圖表用到它。現在週彙總上方多了一條逐日的面積線，標出最高的那一天，並且只標期間的第一天與最後一天。樣式表也加了一段 `@media print`：各區塊避免在內部斷頁、互動控制項隱藏、陰影與位移移除，顏色反轉成白底深字，這樣讀者開著深色模式時列印的 PDF 仍然讀得下去。⟦展場海報改成印刷版時，會把螢幕上的深色底換成白紙深字，互動按鈕拿掉，讓拿在手上的那份仍然清楚。⟧
body.en: The report's header already named the period's peak day, but you had no chart to check it against: `daily_trend` held 30 days of data that no chart used. A daily area line now sits above the weekly rollup, marking the highest day and labelling only the period's first and last dates. The stylesheet also gained a `@media print` block: sections avoid internal page breaks, interactive controls are hidden, shadows and offsets are removed, and colors invert to dark-on-white so a PDF stays readable when the reader is in dark mode. ⟦Turning an exhibition poster into a printed handout swaps the screen's dark ground for dark type on white paper and drops the interactive buttons, so the copy in your hand still reads clearly.⟧

A daily area line now sits above the weekly rollup, marking the highest day and labelling only the period's first and last dates. title.zh-TW: 報表的表格、圖表與區塊層次都補上了
title.en: The report's tables, charts, and section rhythm were filled in

body.zh-TW: ⟦樂譜若整份都同一個力度記號，聽起來就平；標上強弱之後，同樣的音符才有了層次。⟧最重的五個工作階段本來是報表裡唯一純文字的表格，現在權杖那一欄多了一條細長條，比例以這五個裡最大的為基準，顏色沿用模型表格那套供應商配色。作息時段圖以前只有小時標籤，現在會在右下角用低調的字標出尖峰值，沒有另外加格線或 Y 軸。十個區塊本來長得一模一樣，現在洞察與熱圖採用較重的陰影，近期工作與工具兩區則較輕、用 `--faint` 邊框——只動陰影與邊框，因為人物誌那區放了兩張卡，改背景會讓它們的高度差變得刺眼。
body.en: ⟦A score marked at one dynamic throughout sounds flat; once the loud and soft marks go in, the same notes gain shape.⟧ The five heaviest sessions were the report's only all-text table; the tokens column now carries a thin bar scaled against the largest of the five, colored by the same provider palette the model table uses. The active-hours chart, previously hour labels alone, now marks its peak value in muted type in the lower right, with no gridlines or Y axis added. The ten sections shared one identical treatment; insights and the heatmap now carry heavier shadows while the recent-work and tools sections are lighter with `--faint` borders — shadows and borders only, since the persona section holds two cards and a background change would make their height difference conspicuous.

title.zh-TW: 報表的專案與模型列多了佔比條
title.en: Project and model rows in the report carry share bars

body.zh-TW: 十列疊在一起比較時，以前只能一個個讀數字。現在每個名稱下方有一條 4px 的實心比例條——選實心而不是漸層，免得顏色被誤讀成帶有其他意思。甜甜圈的「其他」那一塊以前畫的是配色裡的第七個顏色，看起來跟第一個綠色幾乎一樣；現在改成中性的 `#8b8577`，並且在 `_donut_svg` 裡由一個合成旗標挑出來，不再靠它排第幾個去猜。⟦圖書分類的書背色條若相鄰兩類幾乎同色，找書時就要逐本核對；把「其他」那一類換成灰色，一眼就能跳過。⟧
body.en: Comparing ten stacked rows previously meant reading the numbers. Each name now has a 4px solid proportion bar beneath it — solid rather than gradient, so the color is not misread as carrying meaning. The donut's "Other" slice, which used to draw the palette's seventh color and read as nearly the same green as the first, is now a neutral `#8b8577`, selected inside `_donut_svg` by a synthetic flag rather than guessed from its index. ⟦When two adjacent shelf categories carry nearly the same spine color, finding a book means checking each one; making the "other" category grey lets the eye skip it at once.⟧

title.zh-TW: 還沒過完的一週不再拿去跟完整的一週比
title.en: A week still in progress is no longer compared against a complete one

body.zh-TW: ⟦量體重時把還沒吃完的那一餐算進去，跟上週的完整紀錄比，數字會顯示你一夜之間輕了九成七。⟧週趨勢以前拿還沒過完的本週跟上一整週比，在 2026-08-31 那個星期一就產出「W36 ↘ −97%」，結論說本週輕了 97%。現在最後一週的星期日若落在 `date_to` 之後就標成進行中（新的 `trend_week_in_progress` 鍵，五語都加了），不顯示百分比，而 `_trend_summary()` 改比最近兩個完整的週。
body.en: ⟦Weighing yourself mid-meal and comparing that against last week's complete record makes the scale say you shed 97% overnight.⟧ The weekly trend measured the current partial week against the previous full one, which on Monday 2026-08-31 produced "W36 ↘ −97%" and the conclusion that this week was 97% lighter. The final week is now marked in progress when its Sunday falls after `date_to` (new `trend_week_in_progress` key, added in all five languages) and shows no percentage, and `_trend_summary()` compares the last two completed weeks instead.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 的模型名不再兩種語言混寫，選單列標題也縮短
title.en: The Antigravity model name stops mixing two languages, and the menu bar title tightens

body.zh-TW: ⟦名牌上先印了英文職稱，旁邊又補一個中文職稱，同一件事寫了兩遍；現在只留讀者看得懂的那一個。⟧Antigravity 的 `display_name` 結尾本來就帶英文的強度後綴，例如 `(High)`，`usage` 又在後面接一個在地化的，同一個層級被寫了兩次、兩種語言。現在英文後綴會被拿掉，只留在地化的標籤；`display_name` 裡沒有強度欄位時，被拿掉的那個後綴就成為來源。選單列標題也收緊了：間隔號拿掉，因為供應商圖示本來就把數字分開了，圖示間距也縮成兩個空格。另外，五份 README 都在即時可見度那節補上快取健康度的說明，註明它需要 Claude Code 2.1.251 或更新版本；網站上關於 AI Tool Update Digest 的描述也移除了，那個報表區塊已經不存在。
body.en: ⟦A name badge printing the job title in English and then again in another language says the same thing twice; now only the one the reader understands stays.⟧ Antigravity's `display_name` already ends in an English effort suffix such as `(High)`, and `usage` appended a localized one after it, naming the same level twice in two languages. The English suffix is now stripped and only the localized label is kept; when `display_name` carries no effort field, the stripped suffix becomes the source. The menu bar title tightened up too: the interpunct separator was removed, since the provider icons already separate the figures, and icon spacing was reduced to two spaces. Separately, prompt cache health was documented in all five READMEs under real-time visibility, noting it needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer, and the website's description of the AI Tool Update Digest was removed, a report section that no longer exists.

title.zh-TW: 移除時會把 Grok 原本的狀態列放回去
title.en: Uninstalling restores Grok's original status line

body.zh-TW: ⟦租來的房子退租時，房東的原本那盞燈要裝回去；前一位房客把自己的燈拆走卻沒還原，下一位進門就只剩天花板上的線頭。⟧`unsetup()` 以前只處理 Claude Code 和 Codex，跳過了 Grok。所以你跑完 `--unsetup` 之後，`~/.grok/config.toml` 還指著一支 `usage` 的腳本，而且沒有任何正規方式回到你自己原本的 `[ui.status_line]`。這個情況現在修好了，移除時會把 Grok 原本的狀態列還原。會漏掉是因為舊的測試只走私有的 `_unsetup_grok()`，新的測試改從公開的 `unsetup()` 進去。
body.en: ⟦When a rented flat is handed back, the landlord's original lamp goes back up; a tenant who takes their own lamp and restores nothing leaves the next person with bare wires in the ceiling.⟧ `unsetup()` handled Claude Code and Codex but skipped Grok, so after `--unsetup` the user's `~/.grok/config.toml` still pointed at a `usage` script with no supported way back to their own `[ui.status_line]`. Uninstalling now restores Grok's original status line. The old test exercised only the private `_unsetup_grok()`, which is why this slipped through; the new one enters through the public `unsetup()`.

items.original: **Uninstalling now restores Grok's original status line.** `unsetup()` handled Claude Code and Codex but skipped Grok, so after `--unsetup` the user's `~/.grok/config.toml` still pointed at a `usage` script with no supported way back to their own `[ui.status_line]`. The old test exercised only the private `_unsetup_grok()`, which is why this slipped through; the new one enters through the public `unsetup()`.

title.zh-TW: 週燃燒趨勢的長條改用 CSS 漸層畫
title.en: Weekly burn trend bars are now CSS gradients

body.zh-TW: 同一頁上的甜甜圈、熱圖與作息時段圖都是畫出來的圖形，只有週趨勢的長條是用 `█` 這個字元排出來的，看起來像另一份文件貼過來的。現在這些長條改用 CSS 漸層繪製。四欄的版面與終端機風格都沒變，只是繪製的程式碼搬進新的 `ui/report_charts.py`。⟦一本畫冊裡的插圖都是印刷的，只有一頁是用打字機的符號拼出來的圖案；現在那頁也照同樣的方式印。⟧
body.en: The donut, heatmap, and active-hours chart on the same page were all drawn graphics, while the weekly trend drew its bars with `█` characters, looking pasted in from another document. Those bars are now CSS gradients. The four-column layout and terminal styling are unchanged; the rendering moved into a new `ui/report_charts.py`. ⟦In an art book where every plate is printed, one page carries a picture assembled from typewriter symbols; that page is now printed the same way as the rest.⟧

items.original: **Weekly burn trend bars are now CSS gradients.** The weekly trend drew its bars with `█` characters while the donut, heatmap, and active-hours chart on the same page were graphical. The four-column layout and terminal styling are unchanged; the rendering moved into a new `ui/report_charts.py`.

title.zh-TW: 熱圖不再漏標月份，甜甜圈的百分比跟表格對得上
title.en: The heatmap stops skipping months, and the donut agrees with the table

body.zh-TW: ⟦一週橫跨兩個月時，若一律用星期一那天決定它屬於哪個月，只沾到一天的舊月份就把整週收走；改看星期四，那週歸屬才符合它實際待得久的那一邊。⟧熱圖每一欄的月份以前就是從星期一取的，跨月的那一週被算給它幾乎沒沾到的舊月份，而被間距規則壓下去的標籤還會永久消失——真實輸出整個掉了九月。現在月份改從該欄的星期四讀出來，並跟上一個真正標出來的月份比對，被壓掉的月份會在下一個符合間距的欄位重新出現。另外，專案甜甜圈以前拿前十個專案的總和當分母，下方表格的百分比卻用總權杖數，所以同一個專案在圖上是 42.5%、在表格是 36.1%，中央那個數字也不是它看起來宣稱的總數。現在分母改成 `summary.total_tokens`，沒被列出來的部分（包含前十名以外的專案）併成一塊「其他」，沿用既有的 `report_chart_other` 字串。
body.en: ⟦When a week straddles two months, always deciding by its Monday hands the whole week to the old month it touched for a day; reading the Thursday instead puts the week on the side it actually spent longer in.⟧ A heatmap column's month was taken from its Monday, so a week spanning a month boundary was credited to the old month it barely touched, and a label suppressed by the spacing rule was lost permanently — real output dropped September entirely. The month is now read from the column's Thursday and compared against the last month actually labelled, so a suppressed month reappears at the next column that satisfies the spacing. Separately, the project donut divided by the sum of `by_project[:10]` while the table's percentage used total tokens, so one project showed 42.5% in the chart and 36.1% in the table, and the center figure read as a total it was not. The denominator is now `summary.total_tokens`, with everything not shown (including projects outside the top ten) combined into an "Other" slice reusing the existing `report_chart_other` string.

items.original:
**The heatmap's month labels no longer skip or mislabel a month.** A column's month was taken from its Monday, so a week spanning a month boundary was credited to the old month it barely touched, and a label suppressed by the spacing rule was lost permanently — real output dropped September entirely. The month is now read from the column's Thursday and compared against the last month actually labelled, so a suppressed month reappears at the next column that satisfies the spacing.
**The project donut's percentages now agree with the table beneath it.** The donut divided by the sum of `by_project[:10]` while the table's percentage used total tokens, so one project showed 42.5% in the chart and 36.1% in the table, and the center figure read as a total it was not. The denominator is now `summary.total_tokens`, with everything not shown — including projects outside the top ten — combined into an "Other" slice reusing the existing `report_chart_other` string.

title.zh-TW: 沒有模型名稱的打斷與被擋工具不再被丟掉
title.en: Interruptions and denied tools on messages with no model name are no longer dropped

body.zh-TW: ⟦點收貨物時，沒寫寄件人的那幾箱既不記在任何一家廠商名下，也沒放進「來源不明」那一堆，結果總數就少了幾箱。⟧帶著 `message.id` 卻沒有 `message.model` 的訊息，會被編成一個空字串，但後面的檢查只測 `model is None`。所以這些事件既沒有被歸給任何模型，也沒有被算進未歸屬那一桶，上一張卡講的那個一次過關率因此把打斷數算少了。這次修好了。
body.en: ⟦Checking in a delivery, the boxes with no sender written on them are filed under no supplier and never added to the "unknown origin" pile either, so the count comes up short.⟧ A message carrying `message.id` but no `message.model` was indexed as an empty string, while the later check tested only `model is None`. Those events were therefore neither attributed to a model nor counted as unattributed, undercounting interruptions in the first-pass rate described on the previous card. That is now fixed.

items.original: **Interruptions and denied tools on messages with no model name are no longer dropped.** A message carrying `message.id` but no `message.model` was indexed as an empty string, while the later check tested only `model is None` — so those events were neither attributed to a model nor counted as unattributed, undercounting interruptions in the first-pass rate.

title.zh-TW: 完全沒有用量時，報表會顯示乾淨的空狀態
title.en: A report with no usage renders a clean empty state

body.zh-TW: 用量為零時，敘述句會把零和佔位符號一起填進去，變成 `---- -- -- was the peak (0/day), main LLM 未知`，下方七個區塊全都只寫著「nothing here yet」——新使用者第一次打開看到的正是這個。現在 `total_tokens` 與 `messages` 都是零時，敘述改成 `report_empty_state_hint`，這個鍵五種語言都加了，並且只渲染標題、統計卡與贊助區塊。有資料時的輸出逐位元組相同，沒被動過的 `full_zh_tw` 與 `full_en` 快照就是證明。⟦餐廳還沒開始營業時，菜單上不該印出一排零元的品項，門口掛一塊「準備中」的牌子就夠了。⟧
body.en: At zero usage the narrative sentence interpolated zeros and placeholders — "---- -- -- was the peak (0/day), main LLM 未知" — above seven sections each saying only "nothing here yet", which is what a new user saw on first open. When both `total_tokens` and `messages` are zero the narrative is now replaced by `report_empty_state_hint`, a key added in all five languages, and only the header, stat cards, and sponsor section render. Output with data is byte-identical; the untouched `full_zh_tw` and `full_en` snapshots are the proof. ⟦A restaurant not yet open for business should not print a menu full of zero-price dishes; a "preparing" sign on the door is enough.⟧

items.original: **A report with no usage now renders a clean empty state.** At zero usage the narrative sentence interpolated zeros and placeholders — "---- -- -- was the peak (0/day), main LLM 未知" — above seven sections each saying only "nothing here yet", which is what a new user saw on first open. When both `total_tokens` and `messages` are zero the narrative is replaced by `report_empty_state_hint` (added in all five languages) and only the header, stat cards, and sponsor section render. Output with data is byte-identical; the untouched `full_zh_tw` and `full_en` snapshots are the proof.

entries: **The menu bar no longer shows animated spirit companions; Grok now uses their space.** `menubar/critter_frames.py`, the shared NSTimer and `animateCritters_` selector, `critter_animation_tick()`, and `refresh.py`'s `animation_groups` data flow were removed, together with the 15 animation frames and `assets/critters/lion/`. `assets/grok_mono_menubar.png` and `_grok_menubar_icon()` now add Grok after Antigravity in `_menubar_attributed_title()` and `_compose_title()` when `not hide_grok` and `grok_weekly.percent is not None`, preserving the existing separator behavior; `hide_grok` remains `True` by default.

title.zh-TW: 選單列移除動態精靈夥伴，騰出空間顯示 Grok 用量
title.en: Menu bar removes animated companions and allocates their space to Grok

body.zh-TW: ⟦公仔換燈。⟧ 選單列移除動態精靈同伴，`menubar/critter_frames.py`、共用 NSTimer、`animateCritters_`、`critter_animation_tick()` 與 `refresh.py` 的 `animation_groups`，與 15 個影格及 `assets/critters/lion/` 移除。當 `not hide_grok` 且 `grok_weekly.percent is not None`，由 `assets/grok_mono_menubar.png`、`_grok_menubar_icon()` 在 `_menubar_attributed_title()` 與 `_compose_title()` 兩處把 Grok 加在 Antigravity 後，保留分隔符；`hide_grok` 預設開啟。
body.en: ⟦Like removing a bobblehead figurine and its motorized timer base from a car dashboard to free up a mounting slot for a warning indicator light.⟧ The menu bar no longer displays animated spirit companions, as `menubar/critter_frames.py`, the shared NSTimer, the `animateCritters_` selector, `critter_animation_tick()`, and `refresh.py`'s `animation_groups` data flow have all been removed alongside the 15 animation frames and the `assets/critters/lion/` directory. Grok now takes over that space: when `not hide_grok` and `grok_weekly.percent is not None`, `_menubar_attributed_title()` and `_compose_title()` use `assets/grok_mono_menubar.png` and `_grok_menubar_icon()` to insert Grok right after Antigravity while preserving the existing separator behavior. The `hide_grok` setting remains `True` by default.

entries: **Scaled Windows panels now show all their content, with no blank strip below the footer.** `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` now calls `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()` from a background thread before passing only resize and move work to the UI thread, avoiding a WebView2 deadlock. `usageApplyPanelZoom()` receives the natural height, expands `body` before applying CSS `zoom`, and `naturalContentHeight()` temporarily removes that compensation while measuring, so the scaled layout has enough space instead of clipping cards.

**Windows now counts Grok CLI activity in today's cost, token total, and project list.** `_WindowsTrayController._load_entries()` now calls `grok_loader.load_entries()` alongside the Claude and Codex loaders. If reading the Grok log fails, its matching error handling leaves the Claude and Codex entries already collected intact.

**Token Saver now gives short replies three concrete rules for plainer language.** The `terse_mode_instruction` strings in `i18n.json` and their standalone copies in `usage_terse_mode.py`'s `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` now turn nominalizations back into verbs, cut sentences that announce without informing, and put known information before new information, in all five languages. `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION` in `installer/session_hooks.py` and `__version__` in `usage_terse_mode.py` both move to 1.3, so `_installed_terse_version()` keeps installed sidecars current instead of rewriting them on every session.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板縮放完整呈現，消弭底部空白且防範死結
title.en: Scaled Windows panels show full content without footer gaps or deadlocks

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像裁縫師在布料縮水前先預留延伸長度，量測尺寸時暫時扣除這段預留值，處理完後版型恰好合身，既不緊繃也不拖地。⟧ Windows 上的經過縮放的面板能完整顯示所有內容，頁尾下方不再殘留空白條帶。控制器 `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` 改由背景執行緒呼叫 `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`，隨後僅將調整大小與位移交給 UI 執行緒，避開了 WebView2 的死結（deadlock，處理序互相等待而卡住）。函式 `usageApplyPanelZoom()` 接收自然高度並在套用 CSS `zoom` 前擴展 `body`，而 `naturalContentHeight()` 量測時會暫時移除該補償，確保縮放版面有足夠空間而不裁切卡片。
body.en: ⟦Like a tailor allowing extra length for fabric shrinkage and temporarily deducting that allowance during measurements, ensuring the finished garment fits neatly without being cropped or dragging.⟧ Scaled Windows panels now display all their content completely, eliminating the blank strip below the footer. `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` now invokes `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()` from a background thread before delegating only resize and move work to the UI thread, avoiding a WebView2 deadlock. The `usageApplyPanelZoom()` function receives natural height and expands `body` before applying CSS `zoom`, while `naturalContentHeight()` temporarily removes that compensation during measurements so the scaled layout preserves ample space instead of clipping cards.

items.original: **Scaled Windows panels now show all their content, with no blank strip below the footer.** `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` now calls `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()` from a background thread before passing only resize and move work to the UI thread, avoiding a WebView2 deadlock. `usageApplyPanelZoom()` receives the natural height, expands `body` before applying CSS `zoom`, and `naturalContentHeight()` temporarily removes that compensation while measuring, so the scaled layout has enough space instead of clipping cards.

title.zh-TW: Windows 納入 Grok CLI 用量統計，日誌讀取失敗不影響既有紀錄
title.en: Windows tracks Grok CLI activity with fault-isolated log loaders

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 開啟今日用量面板查看費用、token（AI 計費與文字計量單位）總數與專案清單時，Grok CLI 紀錄會一併出現。控制器 `_WindowsTrayController._load_entries()` 在載入既有的 Claude 與 Codex 資料時，會一併呼叫 `grok_loader.load_entries()` 讀取記錄。若 Grok 日誌讀取失敗，對應的錯誤處理機制會保留已收集的 Claude 與 Codex 項目。⟦像三條獨立水管流進同一個水槽，第三條堵住時，前兩條已流入的水仍留在槽裡。⟧
body.en: When you open today's usage panel on Windows to check costs, token totals, and the project list, Grok CLI records now appear too. Inside `_WindowsTrayController._load_entries()`, the controller calls `grok_loader.load_entries()` alongside the existing Claude and Codex loaders. If reading the Grok log fails, dedicated error handling preserves the Claude and Codex entries already collected. ⟦Like three separate pipes feeding one tank, a blockage in the third pipe leaves the water from the first two in place.⟧

items.original: **Windows now counts Grok CLI activity in today's cost, token total, and project list.** `_WindowsTrayController._load_entries()` now calls `grok_loader.load_entries()` alongside the Claude and Codex loaders. If reading the Grok log fails, its matching error handling leaves the Claude and Codex entries already collected intact.

title.zh-TW: Token Saver 導入三項白話寫作規則，版號升級免除重複重寫
title.en: Token Saver enforces three plain-language rules with versioned sidecars

body.zh-TW: 你請 Token Saver 把一段回覆縮短時，這 3 條規則會套用。在 `i18n.json` 的 `terse_mode_instruction`，以及其在 `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` 中的獨立副本裡，5 種語言皆要求將名詞化還原為動詞、刪除只報幕不提供資訊的句子，並先放已知資訊，再放新資訊。同時 `installer/session_hooks.py` 的 `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION` 與 `usage_terse_mode.py` 的 `__version__` 皆升至 1.3，讓 `_installed_terse_version()` 維持已安裝 sidecar（隨附輔助檔）最新，免於每個工作階段重寫。⟦像一台有三個調整鈕的機器，三種寫法依設定一起運作；標記升至 1.3 時，只替已裝好的小模組換新版。⟧
body.en: When you ask Token Saver to shorten a reply, these three rules apply. Across all five languages, `terse_mode_instruction` in `i18n.json` and its standalone copies in `usage_terse_mode.py`'s `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` turn nominalizations back into verbs, cut sentences that announce without informing, and put known information before new information. Meanwhile, `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION` in `installer/session_hooks.py` and `__version__` in `usage_terse_mode.py` both move to 1.3, so `_installed_terse_version()` keeps installed sidecars current instead of rewriting them on every session. ⟦Like a machine with three adjustment knobs, the three writing rules work together; when its marker reaches 1.3, only the installed small module is swapped for the new version.⟧

items.original: **Token Saver now gives short replies three concrete rules for plainer language.** The `terse_mode_instruction` strings in `i18n.json` and their standalone copies in `usage_terse_mode.py`'s `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` now turn nominalizations back into verbs, cut sentences that announce without informing, and put known information before new information, in all five languages. `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION` in `installer/session_hooks.py` and `__version__` in `usage_terse_mode.py` both move to 1.3, so `_installed_terse_version()` keeps installed sidecars current instead of rewriting them on every session.

entries: **Token Saver now keeps short replies easy to understand.** `usage_terse_mode.py`'s `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` now makes plain language the style alongside brevity, adds a one-time gloss for unavoidable technical terms, and asks replies to close with the result and next step; `usage_terse_reminder.py`'s `_DEFAULT_REMINDER` reinforces the same rule. `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION` in `installer/session_hooks.py` was bumped so `_self_heal_terse_mode()` replaces existing sidecars instead of leaving them on the old wording.

**Token Saver's guidance now agrees with itself and starts in your language.** `usage_terse_mode.py`'s `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` now permits the opening-greeting emoji and a one-line tool intent while still excluding them from the reply body. `_write_terse_sidecar()` in `installer/session_hooks.py` records `detect_lang()` under `lang`, and `_read_sidecar()` / `_detect_lang()` in both hook scripts read it after environment overrides, so sessions without language variables no longer default to the longer English prompt; missing or corrupt sidecars still safely fall back to English.

**Existing Token Saver reminder hooks now update instead of staying stale.** `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` in `installer/session_hooks.py` previously restored only a missing script or registration, leaving an installed older script unchanged. `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` and `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` now compare versions and replace stale copies, recording `update_terse_reminder_hook` for diagnosis.

title.zh-TW: Token Saver 簡短回覆兼顧好懂，技術術語加註白話並提示下一步
title.en: Token Saver keeps short replies plain and clear with term glosses and next steps

body.zh-TW: ⟦像主管交代交接事項：話要精練且說白話，遇到行話加句白話註釋，結尾交代成果與下一步，並換掉舊指引便條。⟧ Token Saver 讓簡短回覆兼顧好懂。模組 `usage_terse_mode.py` 的 `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` 將白話風格與精簡並列，規定不可避免的技術術語加一次性白話註釋，並要求回覆以結果與下一步收尾；`usage_terse_reminder.py` 的 `_DEFAULT_REMINDER` 也強化此規則。`installer/session_hooks.py` 提高 `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION`，使自我修復函式 `_self_heal_terse_mode()` 主動替換既有 sidecar（隨附設定檔），不再停留在舊措辭。
body.en: ⟦Like a manager briefing a team handoff: keeping updates brief while speaking plain language, adding a quick plain-words gloss whenever technical jargon is unavoidable, closing with the result and next action, and immediately swapping out obsolete guidelines.⟧ Token Saver now keeps concise replies easy to understand. In `usage_terse_mode.py`, `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` pairs plain language directly alongside brevity, adds a one-time explanation for unavoidable technical terms, and instructs responses to conclude with the concrete result and next step; `usage_terse_reminder.py`'s `_DEFAULT_REMINDER` reinforces this exact requirement. Furthermore, `TERSE_HOOK_VERSION` in `installer/session_hooks.py` was bumped so `_self_heal_terse_mode()` actively replaces existing sidecar config files instead of leaving them on outdated prompt phrasing.

title.zh-TW: Token Saver 指引自我一致，放行問候表情並依語言載入提示
title.en: Token Saver guidance reconciles rules and loads prompt in your language

body.zh-TW: Token Saver 提示指引消除矛盾，並自動以在地語言開啟。模組 `usage_terse_mode.py` 的 `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` 允許開頭問候 emoji 與單行工具意圖，但仍排除在回覆正文之外。在 `installer/session_hooks.py` 中，`_write_terse_sidecar()` 將 `detect_lang()` 記錄於 `lang`，兩組 hook（事件發生時觸發的小程式）腳本內的 `_read_sidecar()` 與 `_detect_lang()` 會在環境變數覆蓋後讀取。未設語言變數的工作階段不再預設載入較長英文提示詞；若 sidecar 隨附檔遺失或損毀依然安全備援至英文。⟦宛如多語接待櫃台：服務員可開頭致意並亮出名牌，正文維持精練，依訪客母語遞上簡章而非預設長篇英文，簡章遺失時以英語備援。⟧
body.en: Token Saver's prompt instructions now reconcile internal rules and launch directly in your local language. In `usage_terse_mode.py`, `_DEFAULT_INSTRUCTION` now permits an opening greeting emoji and a one-line tool intent while keeping them strictly outside the reply body. Inside `installer/session_hooks.py`, `_write_terse_sidecar()` writes the output of `detect_lang()` under `lang`, and `_read_sidecar()` / `_detect_lang()` in both hook scripts parse it after checking environment overrides. Consequently, sessions lacking explicit language environment variables no longer fall back to the longer English prompt; missing or corrupted sidecar files still safely default to English. ⟦It is like a multilingual reception desk: permitting the greeter to wave and display a one-line badge while keeping the response brief, handing visitors brochures in their native language instead of defaulting to a bulky English manual, and using English only as a safe fallback when records are lost.⟧

title.zh-TW: 既有提醒掛鉤支援版本比對，過期腳本主動換新不留舊版
title.en: Existing reminder hooks upgrade automatically instead of staying stale

body.zh-TW: 升級 usage 後，既有的 Token Saver 提醒掛鉤（hook，事件發生時觸發的小程式）現在會自動同步最新版。過去 `installer/session_hooks.py` 裡的自我修復函式 `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` 僅在腳本或註冊遺失時重新補上，已安裝的舊版腳本則原樣保留。現在系統透過 `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` 與 `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` 比對版號並主動替換過期副本，記錄 `update_terse_reminder_hook` 供診斷。⟦恰似大樓巡檢廣播設備：以前檢查員只在設備遺失時才補裝，裝好的舊款從不更換；現在會核對型號主動換新，並在檢修日誌登記換裝明細以供備查。⟧
body.en: After upgrading usage, existing Token Saver reminder hooks now update themselves to the latest version automatically. Previously, `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` in `installer/session_hooks.py` only intervened when a script file or its registration was entirely missing, leaving older installed scripts untouched on stale wording. The system now uses `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` and `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` to compare version numbers and actively replace outdated script copies, logging an `update_terse_reminder_hook` event for future diagnostics. ⟦It is like a building inspector checking public address speakers: previously only replacing a unit if it was missing while leaving obsolete speakers in place, but now verifying serial numbers, actively replacing aged hardware, and logging the maintenance in service records.⟧

items.original: **Existing Token Saver reminder hooks now update instead of staying stale.** `_self_heal_terse_reminder()` in `installer/session_hooks.py` previously restored only a missing script or registration, leaving an installed older script unchanged. `TERSE_REMINDER_HOOK_VERSION` and `_installed_terse_reminder_version()` now compare versions and replace stale copies, recording `update_terse_reminder_hook` for diagnosis.

entries: **Panels that are too tall for the screen now scale down instead of clipping.** `clamp_content_height()` used the visible frame as its ceiling, leaving rows beyond that height unreachable. `panels/panel_scale.py` now calculates a fit scale, no lower than `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`, and macOS's `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` and Windows's `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` apply it to the whole panel through `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`.

**Codex status lines now install and remove correctly when `config.toml` has no bare `[tui]` header.** Configurations that declare `tui` only through `[tui.*]` subtables or top-level dotted keys previously made the setup and unsetup paths silently write nothing while reporting success. `_insert_table_line()`, `_remove_table_line()`, and `_replace_table_line()` now handle both forms, validate every candidate with `tomllib.loads`, and report failure when no change can be safely made.

**Windows builds now point their hidden imports at the installer modules' current paths.** The v0.29.37 fix restored the missing `wintray.app` and `tui.app` entry points; after a separate refactor, `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still named `session_hooks` and `setup_hook` as obsolete top-level modules. The bundle was never broken — `main.py` imports both statically — but the flags were dead configuration of exactly the kind that shipped the unusable v0.29.34–36 builds. They now name `installer.session_hooks` and `installer.setup_hook`, so PyInstaller can diagnose a future omission.

**Toggling the macOS login item no longer fails when the app was opened by double-clicking.** Without `LANG`, `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` used ASCII and could raise `UnicodeDecodeError` while reading `launchctl` or `gh` output containing non-ASCII text. Those reads now explicitly use UTF-8 with replacement for invalid bytes.

**Claude cost totals now include advisor iterations and one-hour cache writes.** The Claude parsers now read `usage.iterations` and `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`; only `advisor_message` iterations get separate entries, avoiding double-counting ordinary messages. One-hour cache writes are priced at twice the base input rate, and the history cache schema is bumped so existing entries are reparsed.

**Dragging the Grok card no longer moves the panel differently from the other three on Windows.** The tray's WebKit shim turns a quota card's empty area into a native `pywebview` drag region, but its selector listed only Claude, Codex and Antigravity. Grok fell through to the shared card-reorder handler instead, so the same gesture that moved the window from the first three cards did something else from the fourth. The selector now matches all four, as `panel_core.js` already did on macOS.
Moved public contribution and security guides to `.github/` and localized README and changelog files to `docs/`, cleaning up the repository root and updating all links.
Backfilled the Grok CLI card into the Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean READMEs, which had missed the feature list entry, the Hide Sections list and the comparison-table row.
Bumped PyObjC to 12.2.2 and ruff to 0.16.4, closing five separately raised dependency updates in a single lockfile change.

title.zh-TW: 過高面板自動等比縮放，畫面完整呈現不被截斷
title.en: Oversized panels scale down to fit screen instead of clipping

body.zh-TW: ⟦像用相機拍攝高聳建築時自動切換廣角，把整棟大樓等比縮進觀景窗，而不是直接裁掉屋頂。⟧ 當螢幕直向空間不足而面板（popover）內容過長時，視窗現在會等比縮小而非裁切畫面。過去 `clamp_content_height()` 直接以可見畫面高度為上限，超出高度的資料列完全無法看見也點不到。新模組 `panels/panel_scale.py` 會計算適應螢幕的縮放比例，且不低於保底的 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`；macOS 的 `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` 與 Windows 的 `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` 則透過 `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()` 將比例套用至整個面板，確保所有列完整呈現。
body.en: ⟦Like a camera automatically zooming out to wide-angle when capturing a tall skyscraper, fitting the entire building proportionally into the viewfinder instead of slicing off the roof.⟧ When a popover grows too tall for the screen, it now scales down proportionally rather than getting clipped. Previously, `clamp_content_height()` capped height strictly to the visible screen frame, leaving any lower rows unreachable and invisible. The new `panels/panel_scale.py` module computes a fit scale that stays above `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`, and macOS's `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` together with Windows's `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` apply it across the entire panel using `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`.

items.original: **Panels that are too tall for the screen now scale down instead of clipping.** `clamp_content_height()` used the visible frame as its ceiling, leaving rows beyond that height unreachable. `panels/panel_scale.py` now calculates a fit scale, no lower than `MIN_PANEL_SCALE`, and macOS's `PopoverViewController.applyPanelScale()` and Windows's `_WindowsTrayController._apply_panel_zoom()` apply it to the whole panel through `window.usageApplyPanelZoom()`.

title.zh-TW: Codex 狀態列支援點記法設定，安裝與移除不再靜默失敗
title.en: Codex status lines install cleanly on dotted and subtable configs

body.zh-TW: 在 Codex 設定檔 `config.toml` 未使用獨立 `[tui]` 區段標頭時，安裝與移除狀態列（status line，終端機最底下的即時資訊列）的功能現在能正確運作。以前若設定檔僅透過 `[tui.*]` 子表格或頂層點記法鍵值宣告，設定與解除流程會靜默跳過寫入卻回報成功。現在 `_insert_table_line()`、`_remove_table_line()` 與 `_replace_table_line()` 同時支援這兩種結構，每次修改皆透過 `tomllib.loads` 驗證語法，並在無法安全變更時明確回報失敗。⟦這好比水電師傅查驗配電箱：不論總標籤寫在總開關還是分路子面板上都能正確接線，送電前以電表驗證，無法安全施工時便明確告知而非假裝完工。⟧
body.en: Codex status lines now install and remove reliably even when `config.toml` lacks a bare `[tui]` header. Configurations declaring `tui` solely through `[tui.*]` subtables or top-level dotted keys previously caused setup and removal routines to write nothing while falsely claiming success. Helper functions `_insert_table_line()`, `_remove_table_line()`, and `_replace_table_line()` now support both config structures, parse and validate every proposed edit with `tomllib.loads`, and raise a clear failure when no change can be made safely. ⟦It is like an electrician inspecting a breaker box: wiring connections correctly whether the label sits on the main switch or individual branch circuits, testing voltages before power-up, and flagging faults instead of pretending everything is installed.⟧

title.zh-TW: Windows 建置校正隱藏匯入路徑，清除無效模組設定
title.en: Windows builds point hidden imports to current installer modules

body.zh-TW: Windows 建置腳本修復了打包設定中的過期模組路徑。先前 v0.29.37 修復了遺漏的 `wintray.app` 與 `tui.app` 進入點；但在獨立重構後，`scripts/build_windows.ps1` 仍將 `session_hooks` 與 `setup_hook` 列為舊版頂層模組。雖然 `main.py` 靜態匯入了兩者而未影響執行檔運作，但這些旗標屬於無效設定，正是過去導致 v0.29.34 至 v0.29.36 版無法啟動的同類隱患。現在旗標已更正為 `installer.session_hooks` 與 `installer.setup_hook`，讓 PyInstaller 未來能及早診斷遺漏。⟦宛如物流清單上的備忘地址：將舊門牌更新為正確路徑，才能在未來漏載時第一時間示警。⟧
body.en: Windows build scripts now direct their hidden import flags to the current installer module paths. The v0.29.37 update restored the missing `wintray.app` and `tui.app` entry points; after a separate code refactor, `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still pointed to `session_hooks` and `setup_hook` as obsolete top-level modules. The packaged executable was never broken because `main.py` imports both statically, but the outdated flags were dead configuration of the exact kind that previously caused broken v0.29.34–36 builds. They now properly specify `installer.session_hooks` and `installer.setup_hook`, enabling PyInstaller to diagnose any future omissions. ⟦It is like updating warehouse addresses on a shipping checklist: keeping the registry accurate ensures the system catches a missing crate before trucks leave the dock.⟧

title.zh-TW: macOS 雙擊啟動改用萬國碼讀取，切換開機項目不再崩潰
title.en: Double-clicked macOS app toggles login items safely with UTF-8

body.zh-TW: ⟦就像快遞員開箱驗貨：以前若沒人提醒語言就預設只認純英文字母，遇上外文標籤便當場罷工；現在一律配備萬國碼字典，遇到損壞字元自動替換並繼續派送。⟧ 在 macOS 上透過滑鼠連點開啟 App 時，切換開機啟動項目不再無預警失敗。雙擊啟動時環境中常缺少 `LANG` 變數，導致子行程（subprocess，由主程式分支出來處理特定任務的背景程序）呼叫 `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` 時預設採用 ASCII 編碼，讀取 `launchctl` 或 `gh` 產生的非 ASCII 文字時會拋出 `UnicodeDecodeError` 錯誤。現在這些讀取動作一律明確指定使用 UTF-8 編碼，並對無效位元組進行容錯替換。
body.en: ⟦Like a customs inspector who once defaulted to English-only and rejected any foreign package, now equipped with a universal dictionary to replace unreadable symbols and keep shipments moving.⟧ Toggling login items on macOS no longer fails when the app is launched via double-click. Without the `LANG` environment variable, `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` defaulted to ASCII, causing a `UnicodeDecodeError` whenever `launchctl` or `gh` outputs contained non-ASCII characters. These process outputs are now explicitly parsed using UTF-8 encoding, safely substituting replacement characters for any invalid byte sequences.

items.original: **Toggling the macOS login item no longer fails when the app was opened by double-clicking.** Without `LANG`, `subprocess.run(..., text=True)` used ASCII and could raise `UnicodeDecodeError` while reading `launchctl` or `gh` output containing non-ASCII text. Those reads now explicitly use UTF-8 with replacement for invalid bytes.

title.zh-TW: Claude 費用納入顧問迭代與 1 小時快取，歷史紀錄重算更精準
title.en: Claude cost totals add advisor iterations and one-hour cache writes

body.zh-TW: 查看 Claude 的花費總額時，現在已完整納入顧問迭代與 1 小時快取寫入費用。解析器新增讀取 `usage.iterations` 與 `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens` 欄位；其中僅有 `advisor_message` 迭代會拆分為獨立資料列，避免重複計算普通訊息。1 小時快取（cache，將資料暫存以加速讀取的機制）寫入則依基礎輸入費率的 2 倍計價，且歷史快取架構版本已同步更新，讓過往既有紀錄能自動重算。⟦這如同會計事務所升級審計帳本：把特別顧問的諮詢與專用保鮮費列入報銷，依雙倍費率計價並重審舊單據，避免多算也絕不漏計。⟧
body.en: Claude cost totals now accurately capture advisor iterations and one-hour cache write expenses. Claude usage parsers now inspect `usage.iterations` and `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`, creating separate breakdown rows solely for `advisor_message` iterations to avoid double-counting regular turns. One-hour cache writes are priced at twice the base input token rate, and the history cache schema version has been bumped so past sessions are reparsed automatically. ⟦It is like an accounting firm updating its audit ledgers: billing special advisor consults and short-term secure storage at double rates, while auditing archived receipts to guarantee nothing is missed or duplicated.⟧

items.original: **Claude cost totals now include advisor iterations and one-hour cache writes.** The Claude parsers now read `usage.iterations` and `usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens`; only `advisor_message` iterations get separate entries, avoiding double-counting ordinary messages. One-hour cache writes are priced at twice the base input rate, and the history cache schema is bumped so existing entries are reparsed.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣拖曳 Grok 卡片修正，視窗移動行為全數統一
title.en: Dragging Grok card on Windows moves panel consistently with others

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統匣（tray，工作列右下角常駐圖示區）拖曳 Grok 額度卡片時，視窗移動行為不再與其他三家卡片不同步。系統匣的 WebKit 墊片原先會將額度卡片的空白區域轉為 `pywebview` 原生拖曳區，但其選取器過去僅列出 Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity。這導致 Grok 卡片掉入共用的卡片排序處理器，在第四張卡片上做出與前三張相同的拖曳手勢時卻引發不同反應。現在選取器已涵蓋全部四家服務商，與 macOS 上的 `panel_core.js` 保持一致。⟦如同控制台上的四組手把：前三組能平移整座台面，第四組因未貼標籤而只能移動自身；補齊設定後，四組操作手感完全一致。⟧
body.en: Dragging the Grok card in the Windows tray now moves the entire panel smoothly, just like the other three provider cards. The tray's WebKit shim converts empty space on quota cards into native `pywebview` drag handles, but its element selector previously named only Claude, Codex, and Antigravity. As a result, dragging Grok fell through to the shared card-reordering logic, causing the fourth card to reorder itself rather than moving the window. The drag selector now includes all four providers, matching behavior already established in `panel_core.js` on macOS. ⟦It is like a control board with four grab handles: three shifted the entire deck while the fourth slipped because it missed a grip pad; outfitting all four ensures consistent handling everywhere.⟧

items.original: **Dragging the Grok card no longer moves the panel differently from the other three on Windows.** The tray's WebKit shim turns a quota card's empty area into a native `pywebview` drag region, but its selector listed only Claude, Codex and Antigravity. Grok fell through to the shared card-reorder handler instead, so the same gesture that moved the window from the first three cards did something else from the fourth. The selector now matches all four, as `panel_core.js` already did on macOS.

Public contribution guidelines and security policies have been relocated into `.github/`. Multilingual README documentation and changelog history files are now consolidated under `docs/`. This housekeeping cleans up the root directory and updates all internal navigation links across the project.

title.zh-TW: 簡中日韓說明文件補齊 Grok 介紹，功能清單與比較表全面同步

body.zh-TW: 查閱非英文的專案說明文件時，各語言讀者現在都能獲得完整的 Grok CLI 功能介紹。先前在簡體中文、日文與韓文的說明文件（README，專案首頁介紹檔）中，遺漏了 Grok CLI 卡片於功能清單、「隱藏區塊」設定項目以及跨工具比較表中的資料列。本次更新將這三處缺漏逐一回填至三種語言的說明文件中，確保不同語系的使用者都能查閱到一致的規格與選項說明。⟦這恰似多國語言的商品目錄改版：為簡中、日語及韓語版本補印新產品的特色條目、選配開關與規格比較表，使所有語系的型錄內容完全同步。⟧
body.en: Readers consulting localized documentation will now find complete coverage for the Grok CLI card. The Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean README files previously missed mentions of the Grok card in their feature lists, the Hide Sections toggle documentation, and the provider comparison tables. This update backfills all three missing entries across all three translations, ensuring readers across every supported language have access to the exact same feature overviews and settings details. ⟦It is like updating international product catalogs: reprinting feature summaries, accessory switches, and comparison charts for localized editions so every market receives identical documentation.⟧

items.original: Backfilled the Grok CLI card into the Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean READMEs, which had missed the feature list entry, the Hide Sections list and the comparison-table row.

title.zh-TW: 升級 PyObjC 與 ruff 工具，單次鎖定檔結案五項相依更新
title.en: Bump PyObjC to 12.2.2 and ruff to 0.16.4 across dependency updates

body.zh-TW: 專案相依套件與程式碼檢查工具進行了例行升級。本次將 macOS 系統橋接套件 PyObjC 升級至 12.2.2，並將靜態檢查工具 ruff 更新至 0.16.4。這項調整在單次鎖定檔（lockfile，記錄精確套件版本的設定檔）變更中，一次結案了先前分別提出的 5 項相依套件更新提案，確保建置環境與開發工具鏈維持在最新穩定狀態。⟦這宛若工廠保養時彙整五張零件更換單，統一升級操作面板元件與校準測量尺，一次鎖定新版規格而無須分批停機。⟧
body.en: Project dependencies and linting toolchains have been upgraded to their latest releases. This update bumps the macOS system bridge PyObjC to 12.2.2 and the static analysis linter ruff to 0.16.4. By consolidating these version bumps into a single lockfile commit, the release cleanly resolves five separate dependency update requests at once, keeping the development environment and automated checks current. ⟦It is like factory maintenance consolidating five separate work orders into one shift, upgrading control circuits and calibrating measurement tools in a single scheduled pass without recurring downtime.⟧

items.original: Bumped PyObjC to 12.2.2 and ruff to 0.16.4, closing five separately raised dependency updates in a single lockfile change.

title.zh-TW: 「Cloud Observation」主題修正 Grok 過期提示，標題不再被擠壓至寬度歸零
title.en: Cloud Observation theme fixes Grok staleness notice without squeezing the header

body.zh-TW: 切換至「Cloud Observation」面板主題查看 Grok 額度時，卡片標題不再被過期提示擠壓消失。該主題範本 `cloud_observation.html` 貼入 Grok 過期提示列時誤帶了 `codex-stale`、`codex-stale-info` 與 `codex-stale-tooltip`，但該面板定義的是 `.stale`、`.stale-info` 與 `.stale-tooltip`。因名稱不符，懸停提示掉成一般內文，未排版的列失去 `flex: none` 與 `white-space: nowrap`，將「Grok」標題擠成零寬度。修正後該主題已恢復正常，其餘 12 款主題先前早已正確對應。⟦這好比標籤貼錯代碼致使樣式失效，隱藏說明攤在門面把「Grok」招牌擠到看不見；更正後版面即恢復整齊。⟧
body.en: When viewing Grok usage under the Cloud Observation panel theme, the card heading will no longer be squeezed out of sight by the staleness notice. The Grok stale row was previously pasted into `cloud_observation.html` carrying `codex-stale`, `codex-stale-info`, and `codex-stale-tooltip`, but that panel defines `.stale`, `.stale-info`, and `.stale-tooltip`. Because nothing matched, the hover tooltip rendered as plain inline body text, and the unstyled row lost its `flex: none` and `white-space: nowrap` layout properties, squeezing the `Grok` heading down to zero width. This release updates the template's class names, bringing Cloud Observation in line with the other twelve themes that already resolved their classes. ⟦It is like pasting an inventory label with the wrong department code onto a display plaque, causing the styling rules to miss it so that the hidden note sprawled across the front and crushed the "Grok" store sign down to nothing; aligning the class names restores the neat layout and floating popup.⟧

entries: **Grok CLI is now available as a fourth local quota card.** Reads the weekly credit percentage Grok CLI already writes to its own local debug log (`~/.grok/logs/unified.jsonl`), so the card needs no network call and starts/spawns nothing. No session/burn-rate data is available from that source, so unlike Claude, Codex, and Antigravity, the card shows a single weekly bar. Wired into the macOS popover, all 13 compatible panel themes (with per-theme icon styling matched to each theme's existing badge conventions), Windows tray, and i18n across all five languages.

**Grok CLI's per-request tokens now count toward today's cost and spend.** Grok CLI already writes per-turn prompt/completion/cached/reasoning token counts to its local debug log (`shell.turn.inference_done` events), correlated by session id with model-changed and session-created events for model and project attribution. This adds a loader that turns those into `UsageEntry` rows, so Grok activity now counts toward the popover's "today" cost/token total and project rows, same as Claude and Codex already do — still zero network calls. Also added Grok's log to the history fingerprint's always-restat file sources, so a Grok-only session between refreshes doesn't go stale.

**Codex CLI now auto-starts a 5-hour session keeper.** $20 plans hit a 5-hour rate limit window; $100/$200 plans don't. The keeper only pings when the local rate-limit data has ever reported a `five_hour_window_minutes` value, so unlimited plans stay untouched.

**Grok's icon sizing is fixed on WebKit and it is added to the Hide Sections toggle.** Five panel themes (`classic`, `catppuccin`, `origami`, `stained_glass`, `prism_arcade`) only scoped their SVG icon sizing/color rules to Antigravity's card, so the unscoped Grok icon rendered at WebKit's default intrinsic size of zero — invisible in the real app despite looking fine under Chromium-based testing. Extended those rules to cover Grok's own icon container. Also wires Grok into the "Hide Sections" menu (macOS and Windows) so it can be manually hidden like the other three providers, not just auto-hidden when no data is available.

**Grok now uses its own monochrome accent instead of Antigravity's purple.** Grok's brand is black and white, but its cards shipped with a hardcoded purple hex in all 13 themes — close enough to Antigravity's blue that the two providers read as variants of one another. Replaced with a per-theme `--grok` token (mirroring Antigravity's existing per-theme accent structure), matched to each theme's own visual language.

**Grok is now included in the demo panels so README screenshots no longer omit it.** The panel demo generator never got a Grok row when the card shipped, so every theme screenshot in the README showed three providers instead of four. Added the demo row and regenerated all panel screenshots.

**The yearly Wrapped card has a new glow, badge, and overflow fix.** Adds a radial-gradient glow behind the beast art in the HTML report's "年度 Wrapped" section, gives the WRAPPED badge a layered gradient with an inset highlight, and lets the art spill past its grid column so it doesn't read as dead space. Pure CSS, no functional change.

title.en: Grok CLI joins as a fourth local quota card with zero network calls

title.en: Grok CLI token usage now feeds today's cost totals and project attribution

body.zh-TW: 頻繁使用 Grok CLI 產出內容的開發者，今日花費面板現在能如實反映你的每一次呼叫。Grok CLI 原先就會在本地記錄檔寫入每輪提示、完成、快取與推論的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計數事件 `shell.turn.inference_done`。系統新增載入器將這些事件轉換為 `UsageEntry` 資料列，並透過工作階段識別碼串接模型變更與建立事件，精準歸屬模型與專案。這讓 Grok 的活動與 Claude、Codex 一樣計入面板的「今日」總花費、token 總量與專案明細，全程維持零網路請求。此外，該記錄檔已加入歷史指紋的重算清單，避免兩次重新整理之間純用 Grok 的工作階段數據過期。⟦這有如會計櫃檯將新收銀機的每筆明細單直接匯入當日帳冊，各專案開銷一清二楚，無須額外向銀行查帳。⟧

Grok CLI already writes prompt, completion, cached, and reasoning token counts to its local debug log as `shell.turn.inference_done` events. A new loader converts these events into `UsageEntry` rows, correlating them by session id with model-changed and session-created events for model and project attribution. This allows Grok activity to feed into the popover's "today" cost, token total, and project rows just like Claude and Codex, while maintaining zero network calls. Grok's log has also been added to the history fingerprint's always-restat file sources, ensuring Grok-only sessions do not go stale between refreshes. ⟦It is like a cashier importing receipt slips from a new register directly into the daily ledger, tracking project costs clearly without external bank inquiries.⟧

This adds a loader that turns those into `UsageEntry` rows, so Grok activity now counts toward the popover's "today" cost/token total and project rows, same as Claude and Codex already do — still zero network calls. title.en: Codex CLI auto-starts a 5-hour session keeper for $20 plans

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好比隨身攜帶的定時鬧鐘：只在停車單註記了限時停車規則時才會輕聲提醒，若是全天暢停的通行證則保持靜默。⟧ 使用 Codex CLI 的 20 美元方案訂閱者，常會遇上 5 小時限流時間窗，而 100 美元與 200 美元方案則不受此限制。現在系統會為 20 美元方案自動啟動 5 小時工作階段（session，單次持續連線的工作週期）保活器。該保活機制極為謹慎，只有在本機限流資料曾回報過 `five_hour_window_minutes` 數值時才會發送探測訊號，確保無限制方案完全不被干擾。
body.en: ⟦It is like a smart parking timer that only beeps if your ticket has a time limit, staying completely silent for unlimited day passes.⟧ Subscribers on Codex CLI's $20 plan face a 5-hour rate limit window, while $100 and $200 plans do not. The app now automatically starts a 5-hour session keeper for eligible accounts. To keep things clean, the keeper only pings when local rate-limit data has actually reported a `five_hour_window_minutes` value, leaving unlimited plans completely untouched.

title.zh-TW: 五款主題修正 Grok 圖示，WebKit 不再隱形

body.zh-TW: 在 `classic`、`catppuccin`、`origami`、`stained_glass` 與 `prism_arcade` 五款面板主題查看 Grok 時，實際 App 不會再出現圖示缺席、Chromium 測試卻看似正常的落差。原本 SVG 圖示（可縮放的向量圖）的尺寸與色彩規則只套用於 Antigravity 卡片。Grok 圖示容器不在範圍內，WebKit（App 繪製畫面的引擎）便以預設原生尺寸零繪製，於是圖示隱形。現在五款主題都將同一套規則延伸到 Grok 圖示容器。⟦像印刷廠替舊版標誌備妥尺寸版型，新標誌漏了版型而印不出來；補上同一規格後，它也能正常出現在成品上。⟧

entries: **Windows crashed on startup in v0.29.34 through v0.29.36.** The 0.29.34 refactor moved `wintray.py` to `wintray/app.py` and `tui.py` to `tui/app.py`, but `scripts/build_windows.ps1` still hidden-imported the old top-level module names. Both packages' `__init__.py` are empty, so PyInstaller packaged only empty shells and dropped the whole `wintray` dependency tree (`panels.*`, `updates.*`, and more) along with it — every downloader hit `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wintray.app'`, and the TUI fallback failed the same way since `tui.app` was missing too. macOS was unaffected; `setup_app.py` collects the whole package by name via py2app, and the names still matched after the rename.

**The Windows build script now verifies the packaged exe actually contains `wintray.app` and `tui.app`.** It previously only checked that an exe file existed, which is why the three broken releases above shipped without anyone noticing — the file was there, just missing the modules users needed. `build_windows.ps1` now reads the PyInstaller archive contents with `archive_viewer` and throws if either entry-point module is missing, so a future regression fails the release job instead of shipping a broken artifact.

entries: **Antigravity quota now raises notifications, the way Claude Code and Codex already did.** The `agy_session` and `agy_weekly` channels were missing from the notification allow-list, so the two Antigravity rows could run to the floor without ever saying so. Antigravity quota is the one source that comes from a network endpoint behind a local cache rather than a file on disk, so `QuotaRowState.available` is hard-coded to `True`; a stale snapshot now passes `available=False` instead, so an expired cache can no longer announce that the quota has run out.

**The Antigravity rows now warn before the quota is gone, not after.** They had never been wired to the burn-rate forecast, so their `warning` flag was permanently `False` — Claude and Codex warned ahead of a reset and Antigravity stayed silent until it hit the floor. Both rows now register their own tracker. Samples are timestamped with the snapshot's own `fetched_at` rather than the wall clock, because the Antigravity snapshot only changes every five minutes and polling would otherwise read the same payload again and invent a slope out of it. Both rows use a 3600-second window: at one sample per five minutes the default ten-minute window never collects `MIN_FORECAST_SAMPLES`, which is the same as not forecasting at all. A stale snapshot suppresses the forecast entirely, matching what `agy_window_keeper` already does.

**`usage doctor` now catches a Codex history migration that would silently zero the token counts.** Codex has begun writing tables such as `rollout_migration_state`, and if that migration lands and the `.jsonl` files stop being written, `loaders/codex_loader.py` returns zero without an error anywhere. The check warns when the session `.jsonl` files hold no entry from the last seven days while `thread_history_1.sqlite` does hold `thread_turns` from that window.

**`usage doctor` now reconciles its own Claude cost against the official one.** It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` from `usage-status.json` with the figure usage calculates itself and warns when they differ by more than 20% and more than $1. On the machine this was written on they differed by 46.4%, because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate — exactly the kind of drift the offline fallback table is known to hide.

**The project usage card no longer clips its rows on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels.** A panel measures its own natural height by releasing the whole `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Both panels write their project card as `flex: 1`, which means a flex basis of zero, and the card's own `overflow: hidden` — the retro window chrome depends on it — suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would otherwise hold the card open. The card therefore collapsed to its title bar during the measurement, and the reported height was short by exactly the project rows: 877 pixels for WIN95 and 876 for Newspaper against 923 for the structurally identical Classic. The measurement now pins such stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` while it measures and restores them afterwards, so no panel's visual design changes.

**Eight more modules moved out of the repository root.** `quota/` took `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper`; `usage_common/` took `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper`. The shared-utility package is named `usage_common` rather than `common` because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into a shared `site-packages`, where `common` is about the most collision-prone name available. No compatibility shims were left behind — every import in the repository was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped the eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed. Behavior is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: usage doctor 能抓出 Codex 歷史搬遷後的歸零

body.zh-TW: ⟦這像記帳員同時翻閱收據盒與總帳；收據盒空了、總帳卻有交易，便知道資料沒有真的消失。⟧ `usage doctor`（用來檢查使用資料異常的指令）現在會檢查 Codex 的歷史搬遷。Codex 開始寫入 `rollout_migration_state` 這類資料表後，若搬遷完成、工作階段的 `.jsonl` 檔不再寫入，`loaders/codex_loader.py` 會毫無錯誤地回傳零 token（AI 計費與計量的文字單位）數。現在只要 `.jsonl` 在最近七天沒有任何項目，但 `thread_history_1.sqlite` 裡的 `thread_turns` 卻有同一時段資料，檢查便會警告你。這能指出原本悄悄把計數歸零的落差。

body.zh-TW: 帳單對不上時，問題可能不在你，而在離線價目表已經過時。⟦這次的 `usage doctor` 像把兩把尺靠在同一塊木板上，讀數差距超過門檻就亮起警示燈。⟧ 它會把 `usage-status.json` 的 `cost.total_cost_usd` 與 usage 自行算出的金額相比。差距同時超過 20% 與 $1 時便會警告。撰寫這項功能的那台機器上，兩者相差 46.4%，原因是價目表把 `claude-opus-5` 標成真實費率的一半。這正是離線備援價目表可能掩蓋的價格漂移。
body.en: When a bill does not match, the problem may be an outdated offline price table rather than you. ⟦Here `usage doctor` is like placing two rulers against the same board and lighting a warning when their readings exceed a threshold.⟧ It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` in `usage-status.json` with the amount usage calculates itself, then warns when the gap is both over 20% and over $1. On the machine where this feature was written, the figures differed by 46.4% because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate. That is the kind of price drift an offline fallback table can hide.

items.original: **`usage doctor` now reconciles its own Claude cost against the official one.** It compares `cost.total_cost_usd` from `usage-status.json` with the figure usage calculates itself and warns when they differ by more than 20% and more than $1. On the machine this was written on they differed by 46.4%, because the price table listed `claude-opus-5` at half its real rate — exactly the kind of drift the offline fallback table is known to hide.

title.zh-TW: WIN95 與 Newspaper 的專案用量卡不再截掉資料列
title.en: WIN95 and Newspaper project cards no longer clip rows

body.zh-TW: WIN95 與 Newspaper 面板上的專案用量卡，現在不會只露出標題列，把底下資料列截掉。面板量自然高度時會暫時把整條 `height: 100%` 改成 `auto`。但兩個面板都把專案卡寫成 `flex: 1`，其彈性基準是零；卡片自己的 `overflow: hidden` 是復古視窗外框所需，卻壓掉可撐開內容的自動最小尺寸。量測時，卡片因此縮成標題列，WIN95 報出 877 像素、Newspaper 報出 876 像素，而結構相同的 Classic 是 923 像素。⟦像量布料時先把被拉緊的橡皮筋鬆開，才不會把整件衣服量短。⟧ 現在量測會暫時把這類可拉伸子項固定為 `flex: 0 0 auto`，量完再還原，因此面板的視覺設計不會改變。
body.en: Project usage cards on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels no longer show only their title bar while clipping the rows below. To measure natural height, a panel temporarily releases the `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Yet both panels write the project card as `flex: 1`, whose flex basis is zero, while the card's `overflow: hidden`, needed by retro window chrome, suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would keep it open. During measurement the card therefore collapsed to its title bar: WIN95 reported 877 pixels and Newspaper 876, versus 923 for structurally identical Classic. ⟦It is like loosening a stretched elastic before measuring cloth, so the whole garment is not measured too short.⟧ Measurement now temporarily pins stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` and restores them afterward, leaving each panel's visual design unchanged.

items.original: **The project usage card no longer clips its rows on the WIN95 and Newspaper panels.** A panel measures its own natural height by releasing the whole `height: 100%` chain to `auto`. Both panels write their project card as `flex: 1`, which means a flex basis of zero, and the card's own `overflow: hidden` — the retro window chrome depends on it — suppresses the automatic content-based minimum size that would otherwise hold the card open. The card therefore collapsed to its title bar during the measurement, and the reported height was short by exactly the project rows: 877 pixels for WIN95 and 876 for Newspaper against 923 for the structurally identical Classic. The measurement now pins such stretching children to `flex: 0 0 auto` while it measures and restores them afterwards, so no panel's visual design changes.

title.zh-TW: 八個模組搬進新套件，專案根目錄少了雜物
title.en: Eight modules move into packages, clearing repository root

body.zh-TW: 八個模組搬離根目錄，行為不變。`burn_rate`、`usage_rate`、`window_keeper`、`agy_window_keeper` 搬進 `quota/`；`time_utils`、`usage_logging`、`usage_lang`、`usage_dir_sweeper` 搬進 `usage_common/`。⟦這像把工作桌上八樣零件分別收進兩個標籤清楚的抽屜，零件不變，不再散在桌面。⟧ 共用工具套件叫 `usage_common`，不用 `common`，`uvx usage-cli` 的進入點會把頂層套件裝進共用的 `site-packages`，`common` 易撞名。未留相容墊片：所有 import 一次更新，`pyproject.toml` 移除八個 `py-modules` 項目並加入兩個套件，`setup_app.py` 也更新。
body.en: The repository root has eight fewer loose modules, while behavior stays unchanged. `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper` moved into `quota/`; `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper` moved into `usage_common/`. ⟦It is like putting eight loose parts from a workbench into two clearly labeled drawers: the parts are unchanged, but no longer scattered across the surface.⟧ The shared utility package is called `usage_common`, not `common`, because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into shared `site-packages`, where `common` can easily collide with another package. No compatibility shims remain: every repository import was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed.

items.original: **Eight more modules moved out of the repository root.** `quota/` took `burn_rate`, `usage_rate`, `window_keeper`, and `agy_window_keeper`; `usage_common/` took `time_utils`, `usage_logging`, `usage_lang`, and `usage_dir_sweeper`. The shared-utility package is named `usage_common` rather than `common` because the `uvx usage-cli` entry point installs top-level packages into a shared `site-packages`, where `common` is about the most collision-prone name available. No compatibility shims were left behind — every import in the repository was updated in one pass, `pyproject.toml` dropped the eight `py-modules` entries and added the two packages, and `setup_app.py` followed. Behavior is unchanged.
